stem:
Rohan groups these living things: rose, cow, cat, mango tree, hen.

Which grouping uses a valid observable basis?

options.text: Group by whether each living thing seems lucky or unlucky.
Group the animals only by where they live, and ignore every other feature.
Group rose and mango tree as food-makers; group cow, cat, and hen as food-eaters.
Group cat with cow because both names start with C.

teacher.key_rationale: Making food versus eating food is an observable similarity/difference basis for these living things.
